task.question: What city in Spain experienced a fatal incident during the 2026 FIFA World Cup final celebrations?
task.evidence: 20 July – One person is killed by a collapsed fountain in Ciudad Rodrigo during celebrations over the 2026 FIFA World Cup final.

answer:
The fatal incident occurred in **Ciudad Rodrigo**, Spain. On **July 20, 2026**, one person was killed by a **collapsed fountain** in Ciudad Rodrigo during celebrations following Spain's victory over Argentina in the 2026 FIFA World Cup final.

FINAL: Ciudad Rodrigo

messages.content: [Lionel Messi: Argentina's 2026 World Cup final heartbreak "part of my football journey"] Lionel Messi has accepted that Argentina 's 2026 World Cup extra-time defeat to Spain was a part of his football journey. At an event in Oviedo, Spain, where on Friday evening he is set to receive the Princess of Asturias award for sport, Messi, 39, was philosophical about this summer's setback and about his experience with Argentina in his two decades with the national team. "In football, winning is very difficult, and you have to appreciate the journey, because only one team can win," he said . "It happened to us in the final against Spain and in the final [1-0 defeat in extra-time to Germany ] of the 2014 World Cup in Brazil. "That's why the important thing is to be competitive and give it your all to win, even if you can't; to have competed to the point of reaching your goal and to feel satisfied because you gave it your all, regardless of the result." Messi retired from international duty and played his final game for Argentina earlier this month, after scoring 126 goals in 208 appearances. He won the 2022 World Cup and two Copa América titles during his team with the national team. Prior to lifting his first major trophy with the national team, the 2021 Copa América, Messi had lost three straight finals at major competitions in a three-year span, the first at the 2014 World Cup to Germany. Messi said he learned a lot from those defeats: "There are some very positive takeaways. To improve, you have to accept your mistakes and try to put them right. It's important to know how to win and how to lose. "I think that's crucial in our sport because, at the end of the day, in football you lose more often than you win." Messi also reflected on his career and how he would like to be remembered as someone that never stopped fighting to achieve his aims, regardless of the results: "Sometimes I succeeded, sometimes I didn't, but I never stopped trying to win everything that lay ahead

2 June – The municipal government of La Línea de la Concepción cancels a scheduled warmup football match on 9 June between Chile and DR Congo ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, citing possible health risks amid the 2026 Central Africa Ebola epidemic.
11 June–19 July – Spain participates at the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
19 July – Spain wins the 2026 FIFA World Cup after defeating Argentina 1–0 at the final.
20 July – One person is killed by a collapsed fountain in Ciudad Rodrigo during celebrations over the 2026 FIFA World Cup final.
Thousands of migrants enter the enclave city of Ceuta from its border with Morocco.
At least five deaths are recorded.
